id: title:TueHaulund:drain event deletions queued in postgres into the adhoc sweep

review.posthog_relevance: Adds scheduled cleanup capability for ClickHouse event records, supporting retention policies and preventing orphaned data.
review.reason: The observed changes implement a scheduled cleanup DAG and database migration for a new 'Event' deletion type. P1.F6.H1 adds the model and DAG predicates, while P1.F2.H2 and P1.F2.H3 update the pending deletions queries and dictionary lookups. This establishes the backend capability for scheduled event record removal, which could support retention policies and prevent orphaned data
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on the scheduling and execution of this cleanup, which is not demonstrated in this chunk. The tier is assigned based on the implementation of the capability, not the realization of the benefit.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds Event deletion type to the AsyncDeletion model and its cleanup DAG, including database migration, model choice, DAG predicates, and a test.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a new deletion category for events, allowing the scheduled cleanup job to remove rows from ClickHouse that were queued for deletion. This could prevent orphaned event records and support retention policies.

observations.behavior: Adds Event deletion type to the pending deletions query and the count query, including the dictionary lookup and the event deletion type in the filter.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the cleanup DAG to discover and process pending event deletions alongside person and team deletions. This could enable scheduled cleanup of event records.
